newsitem.title: USA: Beard Co to post $10.95 mln gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: Beard Co to post $10.95 mln gain from sale.

text.p: The Beard Co said Tuesday that it has reached a definitive agreement to sell its 85 percent-owned Carbonic Reserves subsidiary for $19,375,000 cash and the assumption of certain liabilities to an undisclosed buyer.
The company said that after expenses and minority interests, it expects to record a gain of about $10,950,000.
Closing of the transaction is scheduled to occur on October 1, subject to normal representations, covenants and warranties.
Beard's operations consist principally of its dry ice activities and its environmental services and resource recovery activities.
